text_blocks.snippet: Yes, it's possible to still be contagious after 8 days of COVID-19, though it depends on individual factors and the severity of the illness. While most people are no longer contagious after 8-10 days of symptom onset, some individuals may remain infectious for longer. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) advises that infectiousness can last from 1-2 days before symptoms appear and up to 8-10 days after. Factors like the initial severity of symptoms and individual immune response can affect the duration of contagiousness.
